en-US.description: Upload a garment product photo or fashion sketch to generate clean standard apparel line drawings.
en-US.error.noSize: The current model has no available size configuration
en-US.error.referenceLimit: Reference image limit reached for the current model
en-US.error.references: Some images are missing usable resource identifiers
en-US.label: Sketch Design
en-US.placeholder.extra: Example: emphasize the collar and pocket structure, keep clean black line art
en-US.upload.referenceImage.help: Optional. Upload a garment photo, detail image, inspiration image, fabric image, or pattern reference. AI will borrow design elements while keeping the sketch image as the main structure.
en-US.upload.sketchImage.help: Upload one existing line drawing. AI will preserve its garment category, proportions, silhouette, and line-art style.
en-US.upload.styleImage.help: Upload one garment product photo or look photo. AI will remove the model, background, lighting, and fabric photo texture to generate a standard apparel line drawing.

zh-CN.description: 上传服装实拍款式图或已有线稿图，一键生成标准服装线稿图。
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.label: 线稿设计
zh-CN.placeholder.extra: 如：突出领口和口袋结构，保持干净黑白线稿
zh-CN.upload.referenceImage.help: 可选。支持上传实拍款式图、局部细节图、灵感图、面料图或图案参考图，AI 将借鉴设计元素，但以线稿图结构为主。
zh-CN.upload.sketchImage.help: 上传 1 张已有线稿图，AI 将保留其品类、比例、版型和线稿风格。
zh-CN.upload.styleImage.help: 上传 1 张服装实拍款式图或 look 图，AI 将去除模特、背景、光影和面料照片质感，生成标准服装线稿。
